note: Local benchmark on synthetic data. Both databases run in Docker on the same machine.

queries.title: Daily metrics per campaign, one site, 30 days

sql.ch_raw:
SELECT toString(toDate(ts)) AS date, campaign_id,
      countIf(event_type = 'impression') AS impressions,
      countIf(event_type = 'click') AS clicks,
      countIf(event_type = 'submit') AS submits,
      countIf(event_type = 'close') AS closes
    FROM bench.events FINAL
    WHERE site_id = 7 AND ts >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND ts < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY date, campaign_id ORDER BY date, campaign_id
sql.ch_mv:
SELECT toString(day) AS date, campaign_id,
      sum(impressions) AS impressions, sum(clicks) AS clicks, sum(submits) AS submits, sum(closes) AS closes
    FROM bench.campaign_daily
    WHERE site_id = 7 AND day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    GROUP BY date, campaign_id ORDER BY date, campaign_id
sql.pg_raw:
SELECT to_char((ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, campaign_id,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'impression') AS impressions,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'click') AS clicks,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'submit') AS submits,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'close') AS closes
    FROM events
    WHERE site_id = 7 AND ts >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00+00' AND ts < '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
    GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
sql.pg_mv:
SELECT to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, submits, closes
    FROM campaign_daily
    WHERE site_id = 7 AND day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    ORDER BY 1, 2

queries.title: Top 10 campaigns by conversion rate, all 92 days

sql.ch_raw:
SELECT campaign_id, countIf(event_type = 'impression') AS impressions, countIf(event_type = 'submit') AS submits,
      round(submits / impressions, 6) AS conversion_rate
    FROM bench.events FINAL
    GROUP BY campaign_id ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC, campaign_id LIMIT 10
sql.ch_mv:
SELECT campaign_id, sum(impressions) AS impressions, sum(submits) AS submits,
      round(submits / impressions, 6) AS conversion_rate
    FROM bench.campaign_daily
    GROUP BY campaign_id ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC, campaign_id LIMIT 10
sql.pg_raw:
SELECT campaign_id, impressions, submits, round(submits::numeric / impressions, 6) AS conversion_rate
    FROM (SELECT campaign_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'impression') AS impressions,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'submit') AS submits
          FROM events GROUP BY campaign_id) t
    ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC, campaign_id LIMIT 10
sql.pg_mv:
SELECT campaign_id, impressions, submits, round(submits::numeric / impressions, 6) AS conversion_rate
    FROM (SELECT campaign_id, sum(impressions) AS impressions, sum(submits) AS submits
          FROM campaign_daily GROUP BY campaign_id) t
    ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC, campaign_id LIMIT 10

queries.title: Events by country and device, last 7 days, all sites

sql.ch_raw:
SELECT country, toString(device) AS device, count() AS events
    FROM bench.events FINAL
    WHERE ts >= '2026-09-24 00:00:00' AND ts < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY country, device ORDER BY country, device
sql.pg_raw:
SELECT country, device::text AS device, count(*) AS events
    FROM events
    WHERE ts >= '2026-09-24 00:00:00+00' AND ts < '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
    GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

queries.title: Hourly events for one campaign on one day

sql.ch_raw:
SELECT toHour(ts) AS hour, toString(event_type) AS event_type, count() AS events
    FROM bench.events FINAL
    WHERE site_id = 7 AND campaign_id = 705 AND ts >= '2026-09-15 00:00:00' AND ts < '2026-09-16 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY hour, event_type ORDER BY hour, event_type
sql.pg_raw:
SELECT extract(hour FROM ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hour, event_type::text AS event_type, count(*) AS events
    FROM events
    WHERE site_id = 7 AND campaign_id = 705 AND ts >= '2026-09-15 00:00:00+00' AND ts < '2026-09-16 00:00:00+00'
    GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
